# Currency Conversion Requirements Quality Checklist: Desktop Currency Converter

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of the desktop converter requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the expected supported currencies and the behavior for currencies absent from a rate snapshot explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the swap control's expected effect on source and target currencies explicitly specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the required visual properties and states of the desktop interface defined beyond describing it as a graphical converter? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are accessibility expectations for keyboard use, focus indication, and readable contrast documented for the interactive controls? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is it clear whether currency names shown in the Russian-language UI must themselves be localized or may use BNM's source-provided names? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015, Key Entities]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the date meant by “today” defined for users near the Moldova date boundary or before BNM has published that day's rates? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are the input number formats that are accepted or rejected clearly bounded, including grouping separators and scientific notation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the rounding rule for exact midpoint values specified for converted amounts and displayed rates? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the meaning of the displayed “rate in both directions” clear about whether each displayed rate is calculated independently from full-precision values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are the amount and rate display formats defined, including decimal separator, trailing zeroes, and currency identification? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Do the rate-date fallback requirements consistently define whether HTTP errors for a date, empty responses, and malformed responses advance to another date or invoke the cache fallback? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009–FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do the requirements distinguish the requested date from the effective date whenever prior-day or cached rates are used? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-010–FR-012]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the “up to 10 days” fallback limit consistently defined as 10 prior dates, including or excluding the selected date? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, §SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Can the under-10-second conversion criterion be evaluated against the allowed number of date requests and the per-request source delay? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is “the user can understand when a fallback was applied” tied to an objectively assessable message or information requirement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for invalid, duplicate, or missing currency entries within an otherwise well-formed rate response? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are recovery requirements specified for unreadable, malformed, or unwritable local cache data? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the user outcome defined when the cache exists but its rates are old, or the user declines to use cached rates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are repeated conversions, changing inputs while rates load, and closing the application during a request covered by user-facing requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-001, §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are Russian-language messages required for each distinct failure and fallback condition, including no usable online or cached rates? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012, §FR-014–FR-015]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK021 - Is the assumption that BNM rates represent official reference rates rather than customer transaction quotes stated in the feature requirements? [Assumption, Spec §FR-003, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are the maximum source wait and UI responsiveness expectations consistent when multiple dates must be checked? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are the supported desktop environment and required local storage permissions bounded sufficiently for acceptance? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, §FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
